limitations: The original numeric decision confidence, outcome uncertainty, gut feeling and hard price ceiling were not preserved in the currently available contemporary evidence.
Later player identities selected with the traded startup picks are asset-resolution evidence only and are excluded from the reconstructed ex-ante thesis.
The repository contains a distilled negotiation-history entry sourced from the contemporary WhatsApp export, not the raw chat export itself.

evidence_basis.note: Confirms completed TeamID 1 ↔ TeamID 2 transaction and exact original startup-pick identities.

Distilled from the contemporary WhatsApp export: Robert targeted 7.03 within a concentrated target window; Marcel opened at 7.03 for 8.05 + 9.02; Robert requested a late pick back; Marcel countered with 12.04; Robert accepted.

decision_context.objective: Move up to startup 7.03 to secure access to a concentrated cluster of Robert's targeted players while retaining some late selection volume.
decision_context.roster_context: The startup draft was in progress, so the decision concerned selection timing, target access and remaining draft volume rather than adjustment of an already established dynasty roster.
decision_context.cap_salary_context: No contemporaneous salary or cap rationale is preserved in the currently available evidence and none is used in this reconstruction.
decision_context.team_window: No stable contender/rebuild window can be responsibly reconstructed from the available startup-draft evidence.
decision_context.market_context: Marcel's opening price was 7.03 for Robert's 8.05 + 9.02. Robert accepted the basic move-up cost but sought a late pick back; Marcel returned 12.04 instead of the requested 11.03.
decision_context.why_now: Robert had several targeted players he wanted to secure in sequence, making the approaching 7.03 slot actionable during the live startup draft.
constraints: Robert did not want to lose all late selection volume and therefore asked for a pick back.
The move was part of a live concentrated target window; delay risked losing access to the desired sequence.

theses.statement: Moving from the 8.05/9.02 area to 7.03 was worth consolidating two later selections because Robert had a concentrated target cluster he wanted to secure before that window passed.
falsification_conditions: The targeted cluster would have remained available through Robert's original 8.05/9.02 selections without the move-up.
The earlier selection did not materially improve access to Robert's intended target sequence.

theses.statement: Receiving a late pick back preserved enough selection volume to make the consolidation structure acceptable to Robert.
falsification_conditions: The returned late selection had no meaningful board or optionality value relative to simply accepting Marcel's opening construction.
Preserving the late selection materially impaired the priority move-up or required a worse concession elsewhere.

alternatives.description: Accept Marcel's opening 7.03 for 8.05 + 9.02 with no pick returned.
alternatives.reason_not_chosen: Robert asked for a late selection back rather than accepting the opening construction unchanged.

alternatives.description: Receive 11.03 back as the late return asset.
alternatives.reason_not_chosen: Robert requested this return, but Marcel countered with 12.04 instead.

price_ceiling.description: No explicit hard ceiling survives in the available contemporary evidence beyond Robert's willingness to execute the final 7.03 + 12.04 for 8.05 + 9.02 construction.

decision_state_at_execution.confidence_rationale: The contemporary evidence preserves the objective and negotiation path but not Robert's explicit confidence level.
decision_state_at_execution.primary_confidence_driver: The concentrated target-window objective is directly documented; no original confidence rating is preserved.
decision_state_at_execution.primary_source_of_doubt: No direct contemporaneous statement of Robert's doubts survives in the currently available evidence.

portfolio_links.description: The Tim 7.01 negotiation explicitly references Robert's simultaneous Marcel discussion for pick 9; both trades were part of the same concentrated startup target-window strategy.
